subject: Private Offer brokerage & co-sell sprint — alignment with CloudReseller
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudreseller.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudReseller Sales Ops <sops@cloudreseller.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + CPPO brokerage proposal for CloudReseller

Hi Irene / team,

Thanks for taking time to sync today. As promised, attaching our draft marketplace private-offer flow and proposed brokerage fee split for the first 90 days. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm Redwood will accept the CPPO with CloudReseller as the brokered partner (we need Redwood's entity mapping and PO routing).
- Counter-propose any margin caps or minimum commitment requirements.
- Confirm who at Redwood will be the billing contact for Marketplace settlement.

Attaching: cloudreseller_signed_mop.pdf (MOP), brokerage_fee_matrix.xlsx (proposed splits).

We can be flexible on timing but would like a go/no-go by Friday so we can lock an AWS listing window next week.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Channel Partnerships | CloudReseller
[sample attachment: cloudreseller_signed_mop.pdf]
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudreseller.com>, CloudReseller Sales Ops <sops@cloudreseller.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + CPPO brokerage proposal for CloudReseller

Samira — thanks for the docs and the clear asks. Quick readthrough and next steps below.

Key clarifications from Redwood:
1) Entity mapping: Redwood will map invoices to Redwood Inference, Inc. (US). We need the reseller to confirm legal entity details for the private offer entitlement.
2) Billing contact: Ben Carter will be the internal owner for marketplace settlement and PO reconciliation.
3) Brokerage fees: we are open to the proposed split in the matrix but need to run internal Finance approval if any single-month fee exceeds $50k.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: Redwood provides a short list of required evidence for AWS (KYC + entitlement mapping).
- Thu 10/24: Redwood and CloudReseller finalize brokerage fee matrix and sign-off on seller-of-record mapping.
- Mon 10/28: Submit CPPO to AWS for listing and request co-sell enablement.

Ben — can you confirm the billing contact and whether the $50k threshold is workable for approvals?
Vanessa — can you take point on the entitlement mapping with the reseller? I will coordinate the DocuSign flow and provide the signed SOW outline.

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[attachment stubs referenced: brokerage_fee_matrix.xlsx]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudreseller.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-22T13:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + CPPO brokerage proposal for CloudReseller

Irene / Samira —

Confirming I will be the billing owner. A couple of Finance notes:
- We can approve the proposed splits subject to a short memo from legal on reseller status.
- If monthly gateway settlements exceed $50k (net), I need a one-time Finance approval which takes ~48 business hours.

Action items for CloudReseller to unblock approvals:
- Provide reseller legal entity + W9 (or equivalent)
- Confirm payment remittance details and tax ID

Samira — if you can drop the W9 to me (ben.carter@redwood.ai) we’ll start the paperwork.

Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
[attachment: brokerage_fee_matrix.xlsx referenced]
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudreseller.com>
Cc: CloudReseller Sales Ops <sops@cloudreseller.com>, AWS Partner Success <pps@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-10-23T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + CPPO brokerage proposal for CloudReseller — internal next steps + Docs

Looping back with the internal runbook and the SOW outline attached (sow-cosell-outline.docx). Vanessa — please run entitlement mapping with the reseller today and confirm the exact AWS account IDs we will link in the CPPO.

Soojin — once Vanessa confirms, can you prepare the HubSpot deal record and add the DocuSign link (I started the envelope: https://www.docusign.com/links/abcdef123456)? We want signatures from both parties before we submit the CPPO to AWS.

Samira / CloudReseller — please send the reseller W9 and remittance details to Ben (ben.carter@redwood.ai). Once we have the signed MOP + W9 + remit, we can submit for AWS listing on Monday.

Thanks everyone — small checklist below for visibility:
- [ ] W9 + remit to Ben (external)
- [ ] Entitlement mapping (Vanessa) — AWS account IDs
- [ ] Finalized brokerage_fee_matrix.xlsx with agreed splits
- [ ] Signed SOW / DocuSign envelope (Irene to finalize)

Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
[attachments: sow-cosell-outline.docx, cloudreseller_signed_mop.pdf]
